summary: Birkenstock Holding plc filed a Form 6-K containing its interim financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q. The filing discloses financial statements, segment results, equity and debt information, but does not announce any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, spin-off, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other special situation. No deal terms or extraordinary corporate events are described. The filing is purely an earnings update with standard operational and financial data.
